versions.changelog:
- Expanded documentation in SKILL.md, including more detailed API parameter requirements, platform support matrix, and known limitations.
- Added a comprehensive cross-platform (OTA) comparison explanation.
- Updated the category tag from "travel" to "integrations".
- Clarified async job status handling and polling guidelines.
- Removed skill-card.md file.

Initial release of booking-com-availability skill.

- Check day-by-day Booking.com availability for specific listings over a selected date window.
- Requires a StayingAPI key for all API requests; a free sandbox key is available.
- Provides detailed booking calendar data including minimum-night requirements and check-in/check-out permissions.
- Designed for use when users inquire about open dates for Booking.com listings.
- No prices returned—use only for availability status, not pricing.
